L3_OPENMETADATA_CONTRACT_PATH.scope: Deterministic OpenMetadata code path exercised via httpx.MockTransport-driven contract and parity tests; canonical CatalogTable DTOs; provider factory; client retries/pagination; error taxonomy.
evidence: Canonical CatalogTable / CatalogColumn / CatalogForeignKey carry NO gold_sql / gold_answer / gold_tables / gold_columns / expected_sql / expected_result / reference_sql / ground_truth / execution_score / correctness / sample_rows / sample_data / profile / query_history / lineage / column_stats / value_dictionary fields. Enforced by test_openmetadata_integration_guards.py::test_canonical_catalog_table_has_no_sample_or_profile_fields plus test_architecture_hygiene_guards.py::test_guard_5_gold_field_isolation.

OpenMetadataProvider is READ-ONLY: only GET methods used; static-analysis guard test_openmetadata_client_source_uses_no_write_http_methods confirms no .post/.put/.patch/.delete calls; public-surface guard test_openmetadata_client_does_not_expose_write_public_methods confirms no write-prefixed methods.

OpenMetadata DEFAULT_TABLE_FIELDS excludes sampleData / profile / queryHistory / lineage / columnStats / customProperties. Enforced by test_default_openmetadata_fields_exclude_sensitive_or_uncertified_data.

MG0-facing packages (t2s.grounding, t2s.solver, t2s.runtime) do not import from t2s.integrations.openmetadata — the provider is the sole boundary. Enforced by test_grounding_and_solver_do_not_import_openmetadata_types.
OpenMetadataProvider fails closed on unrestricted scope acquisition (openmetadata_provider.py:60-64). No silent full-catalog ingestion.
MetadataProviderFactory fails closed when metadata_provider='openmetadata' without a URL. Enforced by test_metadata_provider_factory_fails_closed_when_openmetadata_url_missing.
No benchmark-derived data is injected into OpenMetadata by T2S — the client has no write methods; no scripts under scripts/ or tests write to OM.
Cardinality caps at both client (openmetadata_max_assets default 25) and provider layer refuse silent full-catalog fetches.

L3_OPENMETADATA_LIVE_PATH.reason: No OPENMETADATA_URL or OPENMETADATA_AUTH_TOKEN configured in the operator environment; the optional live-pilot test tests/unit/catalog/test_openmetadata_provider.py::test_live_openmetadata_pilot_connection skipped by design.
L3_OPENMETADATA_LIVE_PATH.operator_note: To exercise this path in LAB, set OPENMETADATA_URL, OPENMETADATA_AUTH_TOKEN, and OPENMETADATA_PILOT_FQNS environment variables and re-run the same test. Certification of the live path is scheduled for the LAB pilot deployment.

provider_isolation.evidence: test_openmetadata_integration_guards.py::test_static_metadata_provider_is_preserved_for_evaluation; benchmark runners (src/t2s/benchmark/runner.py, scripts/evaluation/*) construct StaticMetadataProvider (or bespoke fixtures) and never require OpenMetadata.

openmetadata_write_from_t2s_detected: NONE (static analysis + public-surface guards + grep of scripts/tests)
benchmark_or_gold_information_entering_o: NONE (T2S never writes to OpenMetadata; runtime does not upload benchmark descriptions/rules/values into OM; there is no scripts/uploader that could do it — grep confirms)

protected_holdout_isolation.evidence: V2-P01 did not read the semantic contents of configs/final_holdout/ or benchmarks/t2s/independent_validation/. The optional live-pilot test uses only operator-supplied pilot FQNs (not holdout content).
